description: She wears an opaque floor-length muted blue-green crossed-front coat-dress with a high collar and full sleeves to the wrists. Fine gold geometric borders and cloud-like motifs decorate the front edges, sleeves and lower skirt. A cream patterned underdress is visible at the central lower opening. A broad brown woven sash with circular metal fittings holds the waist; a decorated hanging tassel and small round ornaments descend beside it. Dark brown embroidered ankle boots are visible beneath the skirt. The layered design provides near-full coverage and a soft structured silhouette. No headgear, armor, crown or weapon appears; exact textile material cannot be verified.
